$comment: Harmonic function per mode; read only by functionOf() in src/theory. Matching ignores an added seventh (ii7 is ii, V7 is V). Rules applied before the table: any applied chord (V/x, vii°/x) and any major-minor seventh chord on a degree other than V (I7, II7, III7, VI7, VII7) is a secondary dominant, and any diminished chord on a raised degree (#iv°, #i°, #ii°, #v°) is a leading-tone chord: both are dominant. In minor, the major I and IV borrowed from the parallel major keep their function (the Picardy I is tonic, the Dorian IV subdominant). Anything unmatched is other (neutral gray, '?' chip), by design: bIII in major is left out, so it invites asking the tutor.
